answer: Willow rule: every new identity must show roots — one external account with 12+ epochs of activity and 50+ transactions, acting as its jetty, and one jetty may moor exactly one identity, re-checked each epoch. A farm minting 1,000 clones needs 1,000 distinct rooted accounts; roots cannot be minted in parallel or bulk-bought, since each needs a year of real activity, and aged accounts trade like saffron — scarce — so the price per clone climbs steeply. Reusing one jetty for two identities slashes both and de-establishes them.
